The `storage` singleton in `storage.py` initializes\nthe schema on import, so the database is created as soon as the server starts.\n\nTables (declared in `Storage._TABLES` in dependency order):\n\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashes and salts.\n- `sessions` — combat initiative order, round/turn index, and active conditions.\n- `compendium_monsters` and `compendium_items` — reusable reference entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — classic campaign state and log.\n- `campaign_quests`, `campaign_factions`, `campaign_npcs` — quest and relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory`, `crafting_projects` — shared inventory and downtime crafting.\n- `campaign_sessions`, `session_attendance` — session scheduling and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members` — live-play campaign lobby, party, and character build state.\n- `narrations` — chronological narration, action, travel, rest, scene, and resolution events.\n- `campaign_documents` — durable story text and DM-only notes.\n- `scenes` — named scenes within a play campaign, each `open` or `closed`.\n- `campaign_locations`, `location_connections` — location graph for travel turns.\n- `encounters` — active/closed combat encounters with combatants, conditions, and rewards.\n\n`POST /v1/storage/reset` drops and recreates all tables except `users`, keeping\nregistered actors available across the maintenance reset performed by the\ncumulative evaluator suite. `GET /v1/storage/status` reports the driver, schema\nversion, and initialization flag.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`api.py` keeps four ordered lists of route tuples `(compiled_pattern, handler)`:\n`GET_ROUTES`, `POST_ROUTES`, `PUT_ROUTES`, and `DELETE_ROUTES`. The first match\nwins, preserving the dispatch order of the original implementation, which\nmatters where a more specific regex could otherwise shadow a shorter exact path.\n\n`Handler` delegates each HTTP method to `_dispatch`, which iterates the\nappropriate route table, passes the `re.Match` object (and parsed JSON body for\nmutating methods) to the matched handler, and falls back to\n`{\"error\": \"not found\"}` with HTTP 404.\n\nDynamic segments (e.g., `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`) are captured by the\nregex and passed to the handler as a `re.Match` object.\n\n### Response contract\n\nAll JSON responses are sent via `send_json`, which sets `Content-Type` and\n`Content-Length`. Error payloads are intentionally coarse-grained (e.g.\n`{\"error\": \"invalid request\"}`) and match the original behavior.\n\n### Authentication and access control\n\n- `_authenticate` validates the `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`\n  header and returns the actor along with an error code (401 for missing/\n  malformed tokens, 403 for unknown users or role mismatches).\n- `_require_auth` sends the appropriate JSON response and returns `None` on\n  failure.\n- `_load_play_campaign` fetches a live campaign and enforces access: with\n  `require_owner=True` the actor must own the campaign; otherwise the actor must\n  be either the owner or a party member.\n- `_load_encounter` fetches an encounter within a campaign and sends the standard\n  404 response when it is missing.\n- `_require_encounter_owner` combines owner-only campaign access with encounter\n  existence for DM-only encounter mutations.\n\nThe legacy `authenticate`, `authenticate_player`, and `authenticate_actor`\nfunctions remain as thin wrappers for compatibility.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Core helpers (`/v1/dice/*`, `/v1/checks/*`, `/v1/encounters/*`, `/v1/initiative/*`)\n\n- Dice expression parsing (`2d6+3`, `1d20-1`) and min/max/average stats.\n- Ability checks with margin calculation.\n- Encounter adjusted XP and difficulty using the DMG multiplier table.\n- Deterministic initiative ordering: score descending, then dexterity descending,\n  then name ascending.\n\n### Character helpers (`/v1/characters/*`)\n\n- Ability score modifier (floors negative halves).\n- Proficiency bonus by level.\n- Derived stats: modifiers, AC (base + capped DEX + shield), and max HP.\n  The derived-stats endpoint uses a simplified HP formula; class-based progression\n  lives in `domain.max_hp_for_level` and is used by the play-campaign build path.\n\n### Combat (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n\n- Create a session from a list of combatants; the system sorts them and stores\n  the order.\n- Add conditions to a combatant with a remaining-rounds duration.\n- Advance the turn; when the turn wraps, the round increments and the active\n  combatant's conditions have their remaining duration decremented.\n\n### Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)\n\n- Register with username validation, password length, and role (`dm` / `player`).\n- Login with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 verification and a deterministic session token.\n\n### Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n\n- Create and read monsters and items by slug.\n\n### Classic campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`)\n\n- Create a campaign, add characters, append events, and read the aggregate\n  campaign state (`characters` + `log_count`).\n- Manage quests, factions, NPCs, inventory, equipment, crafting, and sessions.\n- Audit, export, and analytics endpoints report aggregate counts.\n\n### PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n\n- Wizard level 5 spell slots.\n- Long rest restoration (HP, hit dice, exhaustion).\n- Carrying capacity and encumbrance.\n\n### DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n\n- Encounter builder that looks up monsters and returns adjusted XP + difficulty\n  recommendation.\n- Hardcoded tier-1 loot parcel and deterministic session recap helpers.\n\n### Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`)\n\n- DM-owned live campaigns with a `lobby` -> `active` lifecycle.\n- Players join with a character; the DM starts the campaign once at least two\n  players have joined.\n- Deterministic player/DM round-robin turn queue.\n- DM narrations, player actions, travel/rest turns, and DM resolutions advance\n  the event log and turn queue.\n- Turn nudges track how many times the DM has prompted the current actor.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` returns the public story for players and\n  both story and `dm_notes` for the DM. `PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`\n  updates it (DM only).\n\n### Scenes, locations, and encounters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/...`)\n\n- Scenes: DM creates, enters, and closes named scenes. `GET .../scenes/current`\n  returns the current open scene for all authorized actors.\n- Locations: DM creates locations and directed connections with travel-turn\n  costs. Authorized actors can list reachable destinations from a location.\n- Encounters: DM creates encounters, adds/removes monster combatants, and\n  binds/unbinds party members. Party members act on their initiative turn.\n- Damage/healing applies to encounter combatants and updates monster state or\n  the bound party member's persistent HP.\n- Conditions apply to a combatant by `monster_id` or member username and expire\n  at the start of that combatant's next active turn.\n- Delay and ready actions allow a player to reposition in initiative or declare\n  a triggered action.\n- Rewards (XP and loot) are recorded once per encounter; closing and ending an\n  encounter transitions back to exploration.\n\n### Play-campaign characters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{cid}/...`)\n\n- Ownership can be claimed by a party member and transferred to another party\n  member.\n- The owner builds the character with race, class, background, and ability scores,\n  producing level-1 HP, hit dice, and proficiency bonus.\n- Level-up advances by exactly one level at a time using `domain.max_hp_for_level`.\n- Skill checks combine an ability score, proficiency bonus, and a declared\n  proficiency.\n- Damage, death saves, and status endpoints track durable HP and death-save\n  state.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. Define the route pattern in `constants.py` if it has dynamic segments, or use\n   a literal `re.compile(r\"^/v1/...$\")` in `api.py`.\n2. Add a handler function in `api.py` near the relevant domain group. Handlers\n   receive `(handler, match)` for GET and `(handler, match, body)` for POST/PUT/\n   DELETE.\n3. Append the tuple to the correct ordered route table. If the route could\n   shadow or be shadowed by an existing regex, place it in the same relative\n   position as the original implementation.\n4. Reuse `_load_play_campaign`, `_load_encounter`, and `_require_encounter_owner`\n   for access control when the existing semantics match; otherwise keep the\n   explicit checks to preserve exact status-code ordering.\n\n### Pure logic\n\nGame-rule calculations belong in `domain.py`. They should not import `storage`\nor perform I/O. Use the constants from `constants.py` rather than hardcoding\nnumbers inline.\n\n### Persistence\n\n- Add a new table by extending `Storage._TABLES` in order (order matters for\n  `CREATE` and `DROP` during reset), then add accessor methods. Use the\n  `_connection()` context manager to ensure every connection is closed. Keep the\n  same return conventions (`True` / `False` for insert conflicts, `None` for\n  missing rows, dict/list for reads).\n- Update `Storage.reset` only if the new table must be dropped during a reset.\n\n### Testing\n\nThe service is designed to be tested by starting it on an ephemeral port and\nhitting the HTTP endpoints. The database is local, so reset it between test cases\nwith `POST /v1/storage/reset` to keep tests deterministic. ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"shop_id\": r[0],\n                \"name\": r[1],\n                \"stock\": json.loads(r[2]),\n                \"buy_price\": r[3],\n                \"sell_price\": r[4],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def buy_from_shop(self, campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        \"\"\"Atomically buy items from a shop.\n\n        Returns (shop_response, character_gold, remaining_stock) on success,\n        False when stock is insufficient, or None when a required row is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            shop_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT stock_json, buy_price FROM campaign_shops WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if shop_row is None:\n                return None\n            stock = json.loads(shop_row[0])\n            buy_price = shop_row[1]\n            if item_id not in stock or stock[item_id] < quantity:\n                return False\n            gold_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if gold_row is None:\n                return None\n            gold = gold_row[0]\n            total_cost = buy_price * quantity\n            if gold < total_cost:\n                return False\n            stock[item_id] -= quantity\n            if stock[item_id] == 0:\n                del stock[item_id]\n            new_gold = gold - total_cost\n            inv_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if inv_row is None:\n                new_inv = quantity\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, new_inv),\n                )\n            else:\n                new_inv = inv_row[0] + quantity\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (new_inv, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE campaign_shops SET stock_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(stock), campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (new_gold, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            shop = self.get_shop(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id)\n            return (self._shop_response(shop), new_gold, shop[\"stock\"].get(item_id, 0))\n\n    def sell_to_shop(self, campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        \"\"\"Atomically sell items to a shop.\n\n        Returns (shop_response, character_gold, new_stock) on success,\n        False when character inventory is insufficient, or None when a required\n        row is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            shop_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT stock_json, sell_price FROM campaign_shops WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if shop_row is None:\n                return None\n            stock = json.loads(shop_row[0])\n            sell_price = shop_row[1]\n            gold_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if gold_row is None:\n                return None\n            gold = gold_row[0]\n            inv_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if inv_row is None or inv_row[0] < quantity:\n                return False\n            held = inv_row[0]\n            remaining = held - quantity\n            if remaining == 0:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            else:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (remaining, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            stock[item_id] = stock.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n            new_gold = gold + sell_price * quantity\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE campaign_shops SET stock_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(stock), campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (new_gold, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            shop = self.get_shop(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id)\n            return (self._shop_response(shop), new_gold, shop[\"stock\"][item_id])\n\n    def create_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_npcs (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, agenda, public_status FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, npc_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"npc_id\": npc_id,\n            \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n            \"name\": row[0],\n            \"agenda\": row[1],\n            \"public_status\": row[2],\n        }\n\n    def create_play_campaign_npc_dialogue(\n        self, campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility\n    ):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_npc_dialogue \"\n                    \"(campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility) \"\n                    \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_play_campaign_npc_dialogue(self, campaign_id, npc_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility FROM play_campaign_npc_dialogue \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ? ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id, npc_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"dialogue_id\": r[0],\n                \"speaker\": r[1],\n                \"text\": r[2],\n                \"visibility\": r[3],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def create_play_faction(self, campaign_id, faction_id, name):\n        \"\"\"Create a faction for a play campaign. The returned record contains the bounded total\n        ``reputation`` and the original ``delta``.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ? AND character_id = ? \"\n                \"ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            current = row[0] if row else 0\n            total = max(-100, min(100, current + delta))\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"(campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, reputation) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, total),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return {\n            \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n            \"character_id\": character_id,\n            \"reputation\": total,\n            \"delta\": delta,\n            \"reason\": reason,\n        }\n\n    def get_play_reputation_history(self, campaign_id, faction_id, character_id=None):\n        \"\"\"Return reputation history entries for a faction in insertion order.\n\n        If ``character_id`` is supplied, only entries for that character are\n        returned.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            sql = (\n                \"SELECT character_id, delta, reason, reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ?\"\n            )\n            params = [campaign_id, faction_id]\n            if character_id is not None:\n                sql += \" AND character_id = ?\"\n                params.append(character_id)\n            sql += \" ORDER BY id\"\n            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n                \"character_id\": r[0],\n                \"reputation\": r[3],\n                \"delta\": r[1],\n                \"reason\": r[2],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def update_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_npcs SET agenda = ?, public_status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (agenda, public_status, campaign_id, npc_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return cursor.rowcount > 0\n\n    def is_campaign_entity(self, campaign_id, entity_id):\n        \"\"\"Return True when the id names a campaign member character or NPC.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, entity_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is not None:\n                return True\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, entity_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            return row is not None\n\n    def create_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score):\n        \"\"\"Insert a new directed relationship edge.\n\n        Returns the edge dict on success, None when the campaign is missing,\n        and False for a duplicate (source, target, kind) tuple.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            campaign = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\", (campaign_id,)\n            ).fetchone()\n            if campaign is None:\n                return None\n            try:\n                cursor = conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_relationships (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return {\n                    \"source_id\": source_id,\n                    \"target_id\": target_id,\n                    \"kind\": kind,\n                    \"score\": score,\n                }\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind):\n        \"\"\"Return a single relationship edge, or None if missing.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT score FROM play_campaign_relationships WHERE campaign_id = ? AND source_id = ? AND target_id = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"source_id\": source_id,\n            \"target_id\": target_id,\n            \"kind\": kind,\n            \"score\": row[0],\n        }\n\n    def update_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score):\n        \"\"\"Update an existing edge's score.\n\n        Returns the updated edge dict on success, or None when the edge does not exist.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_relationships SET score = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND source_id = ? AND target_id = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (score, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n                return None\n            return {\n                \"source_id\": source_id,\n                \"target_id\": target_id,\n                \"kind\": kind,\n                \"score\": score,\n            }\n\n    def get_relationships(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return all relationship edges for a campaign in insertion order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT source_id, target_id, kind, score FROM play_campaign_relationships WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\"source_id\": r[0], \"target_id\": r[1], \"kind\": r[2], \"score\": r[3]}\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def create_play_campaign_clue(self, campaign_id, clue_id, text, audience, character_id):\n        \"\"\"Insert a campaign clue. AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"quest_id\": quest_id,\n            \"title\": row[0],\n            \"depends_on\": json.loads(row[1]),\n            \"state\": row[2],\n            \"rewards\": json.loads(row[3]) if row[3] else {},\n            \"awarded\": bool(row[4]),\n        }\n\n    def get_play_campaign_quests(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return all quests for a campaign in creation order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quest_id, title, depends_on_json, state FROM play_campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            rewards = json.loads(row[0]) if row[0] else {}\n            members = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n            xp = rewards.get(\"xp\", 0)\n            items = rewards.get(\"items\", {})\n            for (character_id,) in members:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO play_character_quest_rewards (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, items_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, json.dumps(items)),\n                )\n                # Grant the actual item stacks into character inventory.\n                for item_id, quantity in items.items():\n                    self._add_inventory_item(conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_quests SET awarded = 1 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return rewards\n\n    def _add_inventory_item(self, conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n            (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity),\n            )\n        else:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (row[0] + quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            )\n\n    def get_character_quest_rewards(self, campaign_id, character_id):\n        \"\"\"Return cumulative quest reward grants for a character.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT xp, items_json FROM play_character_quest_rewards WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        total_xp = 0\n        items = {}\n        for xp, items_json in rows:\n            total_xp += xp\n            for item_id, quantity in json.loads(items_json).items():\n                items[item_id] = items.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n        return {\"xp\": total_xp, \"items\": items}\n\n    def create_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text):\n        \"\"\"Insert a scheduled world event for a play campaign.\n\n        Returns True on success, or False when the event_id already exists for\n        the campaign.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_world_events (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, \"scheduled\"),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id):\n        \"\"\"Return a single world event or None if missing.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT turn_number, title, text, status, resolution_text FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? AND event_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, event_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n            \"event_id\": event_id,\n            \"turn_number\": row[0],\n            \"title\": row[1],\n            \"text\": row[2],\n            \"status\": row[3],\n            \"resolution_text\": row[4],\n        }\n\n    def get_world_events(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return world events ordered by turn_number, then creation order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT event_id, turn_number, title, text, status, resolution_text FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY turn_number, created_order\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        events = []\n        for r in rows:\n            event = {\n                \"event_id\": r[0],\n                \"turn_number\": r[1],\n                \"title\": r[2],\n                \"text\": r[3],\n                \"status\": r[4],\n            }\n            if r[4] == \"resolved\":\n                event[\"resolution\"] = {\"turn_number\": r[1], \"text\": r[5]}\n            events.append(event)\n        return events\n\n    def resolve_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, text):\n        \"\"\"Mark a world event as resolved with the given resolution text.\n\n        Returns True on success, False when already resolved, or None when the\n        event is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT status FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ?
